subject: Gating Lock Screen Retry Recovery after a Secure Clock Rollback
title_ko: Secure Clock Rollback 이후 잠금 화면 재시도 복구의 출시 게이트
summary_ko: 가상의 Android 출시 보안 회의에서 battery board 교체 뒤 secure clock epoch가 바뀌어 짧은 credential retry 제한이 수시간으로 늘어나는 문제를 검토한다. 팀들은 epoch-bound throttle receipt, service transition proof, conservative delay reconstruction, atomic state machine과 명시적 quarantine을 결합한 조건부 출시 통합을 결정한다. 모든 인물·조직·단말·부품·credential·trusted application·service tool·로그·결함·수치·일정은 Business English 교육을 위한 가상 설정이며 실제 기업이나 제품의 실제 결함을 주장하지 않는다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: Android Security Framework, Secure Hardware and Kernel, System Quality, and Launch Management are represented. We are reviewing a lock-screen retry failure found on service-refurbished devices three days before the factory image approval. After the battery board is replaced, the secure clock can restart behind the timestamp stored with the previous failed credential attempt. The device then interprets an ordinary thirty-second retry delay as lasting between seven and twenty-three hours. Rebooting does not clear it, and technicians cannot complete final inspection. Today we need a causal explanation, a recovery rule that never weakens genuine credential throttling, measurable launch gates, named owners, and a dated follow-up. The launch remains blocked until Security and Quality agree on the same evidence.
turns.ko: Android Security Framework, Secure Hardware and Kernel, System Quality, Launch Management 팀이 참석했습니다. Factory image 승인 3일 전 service-refurbished 단말에서 발견된 lock-screen retry 실패를 검토합니다. Battery board 교체 뒤 secure clock이 이전 credential 실패 시도와 함께 저장된 timestamp보다 과거로 시작할 수 있습니다. 그러면 일반적인 30초 retry delay를 7~23시간으로 해석합니다. Reboot해도 해제되지 않아 technician이 최종 검사를 완료할 수 없습니다. 오늘은 원인 설명, 실제 credential throttling을 절대 약화하지 않는 recovery rule, 측정 가능한 launch gate, 담당자와 후속 날짜를 정해야 합니다. Security와 Quality가 같은 증거에 동의할 때까지 출시는 차단됩니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Kim
turns.en: Quality reproduced 38 extended lockouts in 4,800 refurbishment cycles. Every failure required a battery-board swap, at least one wrong PIN before shutdown, and a secure-clock rollback greater than nine minutes. Clean devices, correct-PIN shutdowns, and clock movement forward did not fail. The framework UI showed thirty seconds because it displayed the policy duration, while Gatekeeper returned a retry timestamp measured in the earlier clock domain. The mismatch survived six reboots and a user-space factory reset, but clearing secure storage removed it. We will not use that destructive step as a workaround because it also removes enrolled credentials and invalidates the inspection flow. The evidence points to clock-domain ambiguity, not a slow secure element or an incorrect PIN counter.
turns.ko: Quality는 refurbishment cycle 4,800회에서 extended lockout 38건을 재현했습니다. 모든 실패에는 battery-board 교체, 종료 전 최소 한 번의 wrong PIN, 9분보다 큰 secure-clock rollback이 필요했습니다. Clean device, correct-PIN shutdown, clock이 앞으로 이동한 경우에는 실패하지 않았습니다. Framework UI는 policy duration을 표시해 30초라고 보였지만 Gatekeeper는 이전 clock domain에서 측정한 retry timestamp를 반환했습니다. 불일치는 reboot 6회와 user-space factory reset 뒤에도 남았고 secure storage를 지우면 사라졌습니다. 하지만 credential enrollment까지 제거하고 검사 흐름을 무효화하므로 파괴적인 workaround로 사용하지 않습니다. 증거는 느린 secure element나 잘못된 PIN counter가 아니라 clock-domain ambiguity를 가리킵니다.

turns.speaker: Priya Nair
turns.en: The trusted application stores failure count, last-attempt time, and absolute retry time in one authenticated record. Authentication protects the values from tampering, but it does not prove that the current secure clock belongs to the same power epoch. The board replacement removes backup power long enough for the clock source to restart, while the replay-protected storage correctly preserves the record. From the trusted application's perspective, a timestamp far in the future is indistinguishable from an attacker moving time backward to bypass throttling. I will not approve a rule that simply clamps every future timestamp to thirty seconds. That would convert a security uncertainty into permission. We need independent proof of a legitimate epoch change before transforming any stored deadline.
turns.ko: Trusted application은 failure count, last-attempt time, absolute retry time을 하나의 authenticated record에 저장합니다. Authentication은 값 변조를 막지만 current secure clock이 같은 power epoch에 속한다는 것은 증명하지 않습니다. Board replacement는 clock source가 restart할 만큼 backup power를 제거하지만 replay-protected storage는 record를 올바르게 보존합니다. Trusted application 관점에서는 먼 미래 timestamp가 attacker가 throttling을 우회하려 시간을 뒤로 이동한 것과 구별되지 않습니다. 모든 future timestamp를 30초로 clamp하는 rule은 승인하지 않겠습니다. Security uncertainty를 permission으로 바꾸기 때문입니다. Stored deadline을 변환하기 전에 정상적인 epoch change라는 독립 증거가 필요합니다.

turns.speaker: Mina Cho
turns.en: Framework currently treats the retry result as one number and assumes all trusted-clock values are comparable forever. That contract is incomplete. I propose an epoch-bound throttle receipt containing failure count, policy duration, secure-boot generation, clock epoch, record sequence, and an authentication tag. On verification, the trusted application returns one of four outcomes: active in the same epoch, expired in the same epoch, epoch mismatch with preserved evidence, or corrupt. Framework may request recovery only for the third outcome. It must present a service transition token created during authorized board replacement plus a boot measurement showing the new secure-clock epoch. Without both, the screen remains throttled and exposes a repair-required reason rather than inventing a deadline.
turns.ko: Framework는 현재 retry result를 숫자 하나로 취급하고 trusted-clock 값이 영원히 비교 가능하다고 가정합니다. 이 contract는 불완전합니다. Failure count, policy duration, secure-boot generation, clock epoch, record sequence, authentication tag를 포함하는 epoch-bound throttle receipt를 제안합니다. Verification 때 trusted application은 same epoch active, same epoch expired, preserved evidence가 있는 epoch mismatch, corrupt의 네 outcome 중 하나를 반환합니다. Framework는 세 번째 outcome에만 recovery를 요청할 수 있습니다. Authorized board replacement 중 생성된 service transition token과 새 secure-clock epoch를 보여 주는 boot measurement를 함께 제시해야 합니다. 둘 다 없으면 screen은 throttled 상태를 유지하고 deadline을 만들어내지 말고 repair-required reason을 노출합니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Park
turns.en: I correlated framework logs, trusted records, boot measurements, and service-station events. The rollback is not a fixed offset; it depends on how long backup power is absent and whether the replacement board has completed calibration. A wall-clock correction from the network happens later and must not participate in credential throttling. The useful service evidence is an authenticated transition started before power removal and completed after the replacement boots. It contains the old boot generation, expected component class, station nonce, and one-use completion counter. The trusted side can verify that the boot generation advanced and that the token was not consumed before. This is stronger than asking the framework whether repair mode is active, because framework state can be restarted or copied.
turns.ko: Framework log, trusted record, boot measurement, service-station event를 연계했습니다. Rollback offset은 고정값이 아니며 backup power가 빠진 시간과 replacement board calibration 완료 여부에 따라 달라집니다. Network wall-clock correction은 나중에 발생하므로 credential throttling에 참여하면 안 됩니다. 유용한 service evidence는 power removal 전에 시작되고 replacement boot 뒤 완료되는 authenticated transition입니다. Old boot generation, expected component class, station nonce, one-use completion counter를 포함합니다. Trusted side는 boot generation이 증가했고 token이 이전에 소비되지 않았음을 검증할 수 있습니다. Framework state는 restart되거나 copy될 수 있으므로 framework에 repair mode가 active인지 묻는 것보다 강한 증거입니다.

turns.speaker: Luca Bianchi
turns.en: A service token proves an authorized physical transition, but it does not tell us how much throttling remains. Suppose five failures produced a ten-minute penalty one second before power loss. Resetting that to the base thirty seconds would reward the transition. We need conservative carryover. The receipt should store policy duration and elapsed progress as a bounded monotonic delta, not only an absolute deadline. On a proven epoch change, the trusted application reconstructs remaining delay as the greater of the base delay for the current failure count and the unserved portion recorded before shutdown. If elapsed progress cannot be authenticated, it serves the full policy duration. Recovery may shorten a false twenty-three-hour lockout, but it must never shorten the penalty justified by the failure count.
turns.ko: Service token은 authorized physical transition을 증명하지만 throttling이 얼마나 남았는지는 알려 주지 않습니다. Power loss 1초 전에 실패 5회로 10분 penalty가 생겼다고 가정하면 이를 base 30초로 reset하는 것은 transition에 보상을 주는 셈입니다. Conservative carryover가 필요합니다. Receipt에는 absolute deadline뿐 아니라 policy duration과 elapsed progress를 bounded monotonic delta로 저장해야 합니다. 증명된 epoch change에서는 trusted application이 current failure count의 base delay와 shutdown 전 기록된 unserved portion 중 큰 값으로 remaining delay를 재구축합니다. Elapsed progress를 authenticate할 수 없으면 full policy duration을 적용합니다. Recovery는 잘못된 23시간 lockout을 줄일 수 있지만 failure count가 정당화하는 penalty를 줄여서는 안 됩니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Kim
turns.en: I agree with conservative carryover, but the current proposal has an operational gap. Sudden battery failure can prevent a pre-removal transition token, even when the repair is legitimate. If we require that token in every case, service centers will replace the board and still strand the device. Quality found twelve such simulations. I want a second path based on two-person service authorization and server-held device history. It would be slower and limited to inspection stations, but it would cover unplanned failure. Security may prefer fail-closed behavior, yet a path that cannot handle foreseeable repair is not a complete launch design. We need to separate automatic recovery from supervised exception rather than pretending one proof fits both.
turns.ko: Conservative carryover에는 동의하지만 현재 제안에는 운영상 공백이 있습니다. 갑작스러운 battery failure는 정상 수리여도 pre-removal transition token 생성을 막을 수 있습니다. 모든 case에 token을 요구하면 service center가 board를 교체해도 device가 막힙니다. Quality는 그런 simulation 12건을 확인했습니다. Two-person service authorization과 server-held device history를 기반으로 한 두 번째 path를 원합니다. 더 느리고 inspection station에 제한되지만 unplanned failure를 처리할 수 있습니다. Security는 fail-closed를 선호하겠지만 예상 가능한 repair를 처리하지 못하는 path는 완전한 launch design이 아닙니다. 하나의 proof가 둘 다 맞는다고 가장하지 말고 automatic recovery와 supervised exception을 분리해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Priya Nair
turns.en: I can support a supervised path if the server never dictates the retry duration. The station may attest that the device entered an approved custody flow, two distinct operators approved the component replacement, and the new boot measurement matches the device identity. The trusted application still computes the conservative delay from the authenticated failure count and policy. The server authorization expires after fifteen minutes, is bound to one station challenge, and cannot be replayed after a successful reconstruction. Consumer builds must reject it outside service mode. We also need an audit result for denied exceptions. Otherwise repeated attempts could become an invisible oracle for learning which evidence the secure side accepts. Supervision changes the proof of repair, not the credential policy.
turns.ko: Server가 retry duration을 지시하지 않는다면 supervised path를 지지할 수 있습니다. Station은 device가 승인된 custody flow에 들어갔고 서로 다른 operator 두 명이 component replacement를 승인했으며 새 boot measurement가 device identity와 일치함을 attest할 수 있습니다. Trusted application은 여전히 authenticated failure count와 policy로 conservative delay를 계산합니다. Server authorization은 15분 뒤 만료되고 station challenge 하나에 binding되며 reconstruction 성공 뒤 replay할 수 없습니다. Consumer build는 service mode 밖에서 이를 거부해야 합니다. Denied exception에 대한 audit result도 필요합니다. 그렇지 않으면 반복 시도가 secure side가 어떤 evidence를 받는지 학습하는 보이지 않는 oracle이 될 수 있습니다. Supervision은 repair proof를 바꾸지만 credential policy는 바꾸지 않습니다.

sections.title_en: Recovery Protocol and Cross Team Disagreement

turns.speaker: Mina Cho
turns.en: There are three implementation options. Option one clamps any implausible future deadline, which is simple and unacceptable because it cannot distinguish repair from tampering. Option two clears the throttle record when service mode is present, which destroys evidence and resets legitimate penalties. Option three verifies an epoch-bound receipt, accepts either a one-use transition token or a supervised custody authorization, and reconstructs delay inside the trusted application. I recommend option three. Framework receives a typed outcome and a rounded remaining duration, never raw secure timestamps. It displays normal retry UI for reconstructed delay, repair-required UI for missing proof, and security-error UI for corrupt evidence. No caller can request a shorter duration or choose which receipt fields are ignored.
turns.ko: 구현 option은 세 가지입니다. Option 1은 비현실적인 future deadline을 clamp해 단순하지만 repair와 tampering을 구별하지 못해 수용할 수 없습니다. Option 2는 service mode일 때 throttle record를 지우지만 evidence를 파괴하고 정당한 penalty를 reset합니다. Option 3은 epoch-bound receipt를 검증하고 one-use transition token 또는 supervised custody authorization을 받은 뒤 trusted application 내부에서 delay를 재구축합니다. Option 3을 권합니다. Framework는 raw secure timestamp가 아니라 typed outcome과 반올림된 remaining duration을 받습니다. Reconstructed delay에는 normal retry UI, missing proof에는 repair-required UI, corrupt evidence에는 security-error UI를 표시합니다. 어떤 caller도 더 짧은 duration을 요청하거나 무시할 receipt field를 선택할 수 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Luca Bianchi
turns.en: The trusted protocol should be a state machine, not a recovery command with many optional fields. States are original epoch, transition pending, new epoch unverified, delay reconstructed, and quarantined. A receipt sequence may advance only once per state transition. The secure side writes the new receipt before returning success, and a power cut during the write leaves either the old authenticated record or the new one, never a mixture. Repeating the same request returns the committed result without subtracting more time. A different token after reconstruction is rejected as stale. If authentication, sequence, boot generation, or device binding disagrees, the record enters quarantine and credential verification remains unavailable until the audited service path resolves it.
turns.ko: Trusted protocol은 optional field가 많은 recovery command가 아니라 state machine이어야 합니다. State는 original epoch, transition pending, new epoch unverified, delay reconstructed, quarantined입니다. Receipt sequence는 state transition마다 한 번만 증가할 수 있습니다. Secure side는 success를 반환하기 전에 새 receipt를 쓰며 write 중 power cut이 나도 old authenticated record나 new record 중 하나만 남고 혼합되면 안 됩니다. 같은 request를 반복하면 시간을 더 빼지 않고 committed result를 반환합니다. Reconstruction 뒤 다른 token은 stale로 거부합니다. Authentication, sequence, boot generation, device binding 중 하나라도 불일치하면 record는 quarantine에 들어가고 audited service path가 해결할 때까지 credential verification을 사용할 수 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Park
turns.en: Framework needs a safe restart contract around that state machine. The lock screen may die after the secure side commits reconstruction but before UI receives the result. On restart, it queries by receipt sequence and obtains the committed remaining delay. It does not resubmit service evidence unless the state is new epoch unverified. We will persist only the opaque receipt identifier and typed outcome in device-encrypted storage; no PIN history, failure count, or station identity leaves trusted storage. The UI countdown derives from elapsed monotonic time in the current boot and periodically reconciles with the trusted remaining duration. If the two differ by more than two seconds, the longer duration wins and a diagnostic event is emitted.
turns.ko: Framework에는 state machine 주변의 safe restart contract가 필요합니다. Secure side가 reconstruction을 commit한 뒤 UI가 result를 받기 전에 lock screen이 죽을 수 있습니다. Restart 시 receipt sequence로 query해 committed remaining delay를 받습니다. State가 new epoch unverified일 때만 service evidence를 다시 제출합니다. Device-encrypted storage에는 opaque receipt identifier와 typed outcome만 저장하며 PIN history, failure count, station identity는 trusted storage 밖으로 나가지 않습니다. UI countdown은 current boot의 elapsed monotonic time에서 계산하고 trusted remaining duration과 주기적으로 reconcile합니다. 둘이 2초 넘게 다르면 더 긴 duration이 이기고 diagnostic event를 생성합니다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: My concern is schedule and containment. Option three touches framework, trusted application, service tooling, and factory tests. We cannot finish every service-server enhancement before image approval. I propose splitting the launch decision: ship the automatic transition-token path in the factory image, keep supervised recovery disabled by default, and deliver the station authorization only after separate security review. Devices without a pre-removal token would remain in the existing manual escalation flow. Security must confirm that disabling the supervised path cannot block normal consumer unlock or create a downgrade ambiguity. Quality must prove that the automatic path covers planned refurbishment and that unsupported cases fail visibly rather than waiting for a fictional deadline.
turns.ko: 일정과 containment가 걱정됩니다. Option 3은 framework, trusted application, service tooling, factory test를 건드립니다. Image approval 전에 모든 service-server enhancement를 끝낼 수 없습니다. Launch decision을 분리하겠습니다. Factory image에는 automatic transition-token path를 넣고 supervised recovery는 default off로 유지하며 station authorization은 별도 security review 뒤 제공합니다. Pre-removal token이 없는 device는 기존 manual escalation flow에 남습니다. Security는 supervised path를 꺼도 normal consumer unlock을 막거나 downgrade ambiguity를 만들지 않는지 확인해야 합니다. Quality는 automatic path가 planned refurbishment를 처리하고 unsupported case가 허구 deadline을 기다리는 대신 명확하게 실패함을 증명해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Priya Nair
turns.en: I accept the split with one condition: the receipt format and state machine must include the supervised state now, even though production policy rejects that transition. Otherwise a later tool update could require an incompatible trusted-storage migration. Priya owns receipt authentication, conservative delay reconstruction, and quarantine by November 14 at 15:00 KST. Luca owns atomic sequence transitions, replay behavior, and power-cut recovery by November 14 at 20:00. Mina owns the typed framework API and UI outcomes by November 15 at noon. Owen owns restart reconciliation and privacy review by November 15 at 16:00. Grace owns the fault matrix, and Daniel owns launch disposition and service communication. No remote configuration may reduce a reconstructed delay.
turns.ko: 한 가지 조건으로 분리안에 동의합니다. Production policy가 해당 transition을 거부하더라도 receipt format과 state machine에는 supervised state를 지금 포함해야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 나중 tool update가 incompatible trusted-storage migration을 요구할 수 있습니다. Priya는 11월 14일 15:00 KST까지 receipt authentication, conservative delay reconstruction, quarantine을 담당합니다. Luca는 11월 14일 20:00까지 atomic sequence transition, replay behavior, power-cut recovery를 맡습니다. Mina는 11월 15일 정오까지 typed framework API와 UI outcome, Owen은 11월 15일 16:00까지 restart reconciliation과 privacy review를 담당합니다. Grace는 fault matrix, Daniel은 launch disposition과 service communication을 맡습니다. Remote configuration은 reconstructed delay를 줄일 수 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Kim
turns.en: Acceptance has seven gates. Correctness requires every proven epoch change to reconstruct the same or longer penalty than an uninterrupted control device with the same failure count. Security requires zero recovery from a missing, expired, replayed, cross-device, or wrong-component token. Durability requires one committed result across 3,000 power cuts at each state transition. Usability requires planned refurbishment to reach normal credential entry within the reconstructed policy duration, never beyond that duration by more than two seconds. Visibility requires unsupported repair and corruption to show distinct terminal reasons within five seconds. Compatibility requires old framework and new trusted code, plus new framework and old trusted code, to fail closed. Privacy requires no credential or operator identity in framework telemetry.
turns.ko: Acceptance gate는 일곱 개입니다. Correctness는 증명된 모든 epoch change가 같은 failure count를 가진 uninterrupted control device와 같거나 더 긴 penalty를 재구축해야 합니다. Security는 missing, expired, replayed, cross-device, wrong-component token으로 recovery 0건입니다. Durability는 각 state transition에서 power cut 3,000회 동안 committed result 하나를 유지해야 합니다. Usability는 planned refurbishment가 reconstructed policy duration 안에 normal credential entry에 도달하고 그 duration을 2초 넘게 초과하지 않아야 합니다. Visibility는 unsupported repair와 corruption이 5초 안에 서로 다른 terminal reason을 보여야 합니다. Compatibility는 old framework/new trusted code와 new framework/old trusted code가 fail closed해야 합니다. Privacy는 framework telemetry에 credential이나 operator identity가 없어야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Luca Bianchi
turns.en: Fault injection will cover clock rollback from one second to forty-eight hours, failure counts from one to twelve, power loss before and after every authenticated write, duplicate completion, delayed completion, component mismatch, boot-generation wrap simulation, storage corruption, and trusted-process restart. We will compare reconstructed delay against an oracle built from policy duration and authenticated elapsed progress. The test harness cannot tell the secure side what answer to return; it observes the result afterward. For downgrade, older trusted code sees the new receipt version as nonauthorizing and preserves the record. Newer trusted code reads the old record only in the original epoch and refuses recovery after an epoch mismatch. There is no conversion path that discards evidence.
turns.ko: Fault injection은 1초~48시간 clock rollback, failure count 1~12, 모든 authenticated write 전후 power loss, duplicate completion, delayed completion, component mismatch, boot-generation wrap simulation, storage corruption, trusted-process restart를 포함합니다. Reconstructed delay를 policy duration과 authenticated elapsed progress로 만든 oracle과 비교합니다. Test harness는 secure side에 정답을 알려 줄 수 없고 결과를 나중에 관찰합니다. Downgrade에서 older trusted code는 새 receipt version을 nonauthorizing으로 보고 record를 보존합니다. Newer trusted code는 original epoch에서만 old record를 읽고 epoch mismatch 뒤 recovery를 거부합니다. Evidence를 버리는 conversion path는 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Mina Cho
turns.en: Framework rollback has two separate switches. The first disables submission of repair evidence while retaining typed outcomes and explicit repair-required UI. The second disables the new countdown reconciliation and returns to trusted-side polling, but it cannot reinterpret an epoch mismatch as an ordinary deadline. Neither switch clears a receipt, changes failure count, or makes corrupt evidence usable. Metrics are counts by outcome, policy bucket, and repair path with coarse timing; they exclude device identifiers, station identifiers, and exact timestamps. A spike in epoch mismatch without service evidence stops factory image expansion, while corrupt receipts stop all affected processing and open a security incident. Rollback narrows behavior; it never grants access.
turns.ko: Framework rollback은 별도 switch 두 개입니다. 첫 번째는 typed outcome과 명시적 repair-required UI는 유지하며 repair evidence 제출을 끕니다. 두 번째는 새 countdown reconciliation을 끄고 trusted-side polling으로 돌아가지만 epoch mismatch를 ordinary deadline으로 재해석할 수 없습니다. 어느 switch도 receipt를 지우거나 failure count를 바꾸거나 corrupt evidence를 사용 가능하게 만들지 않습니다. Metric은 coarse timing과 outcome, policy bucket, repair path별 count이며 device identifier, station identifier, exact timestamp를 제외합니다. Service evidence 없는 epoch mismatch 급증은 factory image 확대를 중단하고 corrupt receipt는 모든 관련 처리를 중단해 security incident를 엽니다. Rollback은 behavior를 좁힐 뿐 access를 허용하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Park
turns.en: The validation matrix uses 60 devices across planned board replacement, sudden battery failure, ordinary reboot, network time correction, and attempted tampering. Planned replacement runs both clean and throttled states, with power removed for one minute, thirty minutes, and six hours. We will retain receipt sequence, typed outcome, reconstructed duration, boot measurement result, token consumption result, and UI transition time. Raw credentials and exact station identities are never collected. The first integration dashboard is due November 16 at 10:30 KST. I will break results down by evidence path and failure count so an easy clean-device majority cannot hide incorrect behavior in heavily throttled cases.
turns.ko: Validation matrix는 planned board replacement, sudden battery failure, ordinary reboot, network time correction, attempted tampering에 걸쳐 device 60대를 사용합니다. Planned replacement는 clean·throttled state를 모두 실행하고 power removal은 1분, 30분, 6시간입니다. Receipt sequence, typed outcome, reconstructed duration, boot measurement result, token consumption result, UI transition time을 보존합니다. Raw credential과 exact station identity는 수집하지 않습니다. 첫 integration dashboard는 11월 16일 10:30 KST까지입니다. 쉬운 clean-device 다수가 heavily throttled case의 incorrect behavior를 숨기지 않도록 evidence path와 failure count별로 결과를 나누겠습니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Kim
turns.en: Quality will run 18,000 cycles, including 6,000 with valid transition tokens, 6,000 with malformed or replayed evidence, and 6,000 controls without clock rollback. Every accepted recovery is paired with an uninterrupted oracle device. We will manually inspect all cases where reconstructed delay is shorter than the oracle, every quarantine, and every UI result that takes longer than five seconds. The automatic path must pass at cold, room, and hot temperatures because secure-clock calibration time changes with temperature. Complete results are due November 17 at 13:00 KST. A single unauthorized shortening is a launch blocker; a visible refusal pauses refurbishment expansion but does not weaken the credential boundary.
turns.ko: Quality는 valid transition token 6,000회, malformed 또는 replayed evidence 6,000회, clock rollback 없는 control 6,000회를 포함해 18,000 cycle을 실행합니다. Accepted recovery마다 uninterrupted oracle device를 짝지어 비교합니다. Reconstructed delay가 oracle보다 짧은 모든 case, 모든 quarantine, 5초 넘는 모든 UI result를 수동 검토합니다. Secure-clock calibration time이 temperature에 따라 달라지므로 automatic path는 cold, room, hot temperature에서 통과해야 합니다. Complete result는 11월 17일 13:00 KST까지입니다. Unauthorized shortening 한 건도 launch blocker이며 visible refusal은 refurbishment 확대를 pause하지만 credential boundary를 약화하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: Rollout begins on the refurbishment line only; consumer field devices receive no recovery policy change. We start with two stations and fifty planned replacements, then expand to ten stations after twenty-four hours with zero security violation, zero unexplained quarantine, and 100 percent token audit delivery. Expansion stops if any station can reuse a token, if reconstructed delay is shorter than the oracle, or if unsupported repair shows an ordinary countdown. The factory image may be approved only after the full automatic-path matrix passes. Supervised authorization remains production-off and requires a separate threat review, station penetration test, and change approval. Marketing dates do not override these gates.
turns.ko: Rollout은 refurbishment line에서만 시작하고 consumer field device에는 recovery policy change가 없습니다. Station 2곳과 planned replacement 50대로 시작한 뒤 security violation 0건, unexplained quarantine 0건, token audit delivery 100%로 24시간이 지나면 station 10곳으로 확대합니다. 어떤 station이 token을 재사용하거나 reconstructed delay가 oracle보다 짧거나 unsupported repair가 ordinary countdown을 표시하면 확대를 중단합니다. Full automatic-path matrix가 통과해야 factory image를 승인할 수 있습니다. Supervised authorization은 production-off로 남고 별도 threat review, station penetration test, change approval이 필요합니다. Marketing date는 이 gate를 무시할 수 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: The decision is conditional launch integration of the automatic transition-token path with conservative delay reconstruction, atomic receipt sequencing, typed outcomes, and explicit quarantine. It is not approval for supervised recovery or consumer deployment. The launch decision meeting is November 17 at 16:30 KST with all six participants. The technical checkpoint is November 16 at 15:00 KST. If automatic recovery fails, the image ships only the typed epoch-mismatch detection and repair-required UI; planned refurbishment continues through manual escalation. If compatibility fails, the entire receipt change is removed. I will circulate the owner table, test links, rollback boundaries, and stop rules by November 14 at 09:30 KST. We have a bounded plan and a clear security boundary. The meeting is closed.
turns.ko: 결정은 conservative delay reconstruction, atomic receipt sequencing, typed outcome, explicit quarantine을 포함한 automatic transition-token path의 조건부 launch integration입니다. Supervised recovery나 consumer deployment 승인이 아닙니다. Launch decision meeting은 11월 17일 16:30 KST이며 여섯 명 모두 참석합니다. Technical checkpoint는 11월 16일 15:00 KST입니다. Automatic recovery가 실패하면 image에는 typed epoch-mismatch detection과 repair-required UI만 넣고 planned refurbishment는 manual escalation으로 계속합니다. Compatibility가 실패하면 receipt change 전체를 제거합니다. 11월 14일 09:30 KST까지 owner table, test link, rollback boundary, stop rule을 배포하겠습니다. 제한된 계획과 명확한 security boundary가 마련됐습니다. 회의를 마칩니다.

expressions.usage_ko: 서로 다른 시간 기준이 충돌하는 원인을 설명할 때
